answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 16 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 545 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The knoll of the design is public, the mesa of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the wander of honest work is what finally pays.
